placements.why: Both expressions are this envelope's contribution to the theme that decisions must be captured at the moment of consensus with zero extra steps: the shipped widget (src-1) is the concrete implementation of that capture mechanism, and the Zephyr integration (src-3) is what lets it intercept consensus inside any existing chat thread without separate plugins — the exact 'zero extra steps' framing this leaf already carries. Neither states a new theme; both feed the existing one.
